numbers: 罐中纸页「近一个世纪」未启（原文只给 years / a century 级表述）；她童年发现此洞

facts.fact: 「我早该知道」：仅你不足保护学院；父亲的账本与波本记忆涌回
facts.anchor: That you alone were not enough to protect it.
facts.verbatim: That you alone were not enough to protect it.

facts.fact: 童年旧路：故居与校长官邸之间、崖边的历史墓地（门锁防学生，她少数有钥匙）
facts.anchor: a historic cemetery perched on the edge of a cliff
facts.verbatim: a historic cemetery perched on the edge of a cliff

facts.fact: 下坡两次滑倒、肩扭伤（角度不同则颅骨粉碎），弃鞋穿袜继续
facts.anchor: it would have meant a crushed skull
facts.verbatim: it would have meant a crushed skull

facts.fact: 入岩缝：脚先、没到肋骨、脚尖触底；滑进山的「扭曲心脏」
facts.anchor: my toes brushed the cave floor
facts.verbatim: my toes brushed the cave floor

facts.fact: 洞中哭喊：学院将关使她与你脱锚，收藏将被拆散拍卖，她将一无所有
facts.anchor: your collection would be broken up and auctioned off
facts.verbatim: your collection would be broken up and auctioned off

facts.fact: 此洞是童年躲藏与尖叫之处；如今在家与档案馆都不能尖叫，恐惧中像孩子跑向安全处
facts.anchor: We ran to where we knew we were safe.
facts.verbatim: We ran to where we knew we were safe.

facts.fact: 石堆如临时坟墓下挖出砂砾罐：浑浊粘稠淡绿液体中泡着卷页（你手写之物）
结尾掷碎罐、玻璃嵌脚、血泊中捧出湿纸团，认出《Dreams of the Rose》
